## db63430eeffa

**A-DB6-001 — Reproduced permissive-control and texture-contract defects.** Audited generator SHA-256: `7c732860b8701c13d24771feba4fbaec9103d541a7c8c903ff42c16a596dd581`; selected-test SHA-256: `5976e0994e98fd28b4686a21ad985990c153723e873611f3bed22b8d8e0d68af`.

Two independent public stages reproduce the contract problem:

1. The override matrix completed 119,700 draws (104,760 accepted) but classified the stage advisory because `__override_contract_unknown_axis__` was silently accepted through `**overrides`. A misspelled or renamed axis can therefore appear to work.
2. Defect lint fails with one issue and six warnings: `square_diagonal` appears in the ordinary `AXES['texture'].valid` domain while also declared degenerate; the same texture passes `self_check`; and sample index accepts `True`, `False`, `1.0`, `"1"`, and `-1`.

Reproductions from `packet_root`:

```text
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles check db63430eeffa \
  --stage override --timeout 1200 --phase before \
  --out ../checks/audit/db63430eeffa/override-current

python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles check db63430eeffa \
  --stage defect_lint --timeout 1800 --phase before \
  --out ../checks/audit/db63430eeffa/defect-current
```

Evidence: `checks/audit/db63430eeffa/finding.json`, the override results/log, and the defect-lint log named there. Suggested repair: reject unknown controls and invalid scalar types at entry, then remove `square_diagonal` from the ordinary domain or classify it consistently as lawful only if intentional. I did not modify the audited target.
